hook.line: Target will pay you up to $8,000 a month to work from home.
hook.visual: Creator points up at a pink-boxed 'Target will pay you $8,000/month' title, holding a laptop showing the red Target logo.

beats.what: Money claim spoken and shown as a two-line title above her head; Target logo on the laptop in frame
First cut to the laptop screen: Google search for the Target affiliate program, finger tapping the first link
Product page of an espresso machine: 'the more expensive the product, the higher the commission'
Pinterest business hub on screen, finger pointing at 'Create pin'
Pin form filled in; 'don't forget this next part' tease before the link step
Hand-drawn red arrows and a circle around the 'Add a link' field
Pinterest search results grid showing the published pin among others
Back to her face with the laptop; 'Affiliate Marketing' title names the method
Earnings screenshot '$1,179.33' pops up over the laptop as proof
'Follow & Comment READY' title, she points down at it

characters.enters: In frame from the first frame, held at chest height
characters.acts: Acts as a branded sign under her face, then the camera moves into its screen for every step of the tutorial
characters.exits: The shot pulls back out of the screen to her face at 35 s

why_it_works: A big-brand name plus a monthly dollar figure in the first sentence and title, so the payoff is clear before any explanation
Every step is shown on a real screen with a finger pointing at the exact button, so it feels doable rather than theoretical
A 'don't forget this next part' line right before the affiliate-link step resets attention mid-video
Comment-keyword CTA ('READY') turns curiosity into comments and a DM funnel
weaknesses: Income claim is generic and the $1,179 screenshot is not tied to Target, which reads as bait
Small screen text on the laptop is hard to read on a phone
Long 14 s shot stretches with no change of framing
for_robert: Hold a prop that carries the topic's logo in the opening shot, then 'dive into' it for the demo and pull back out; Fred could live inside that laptop screen and swim out when the shot returns to Robert.
